name: CategoryTheory.induct_on_objects
script:
intro J _ _ p j₀ h0 h1 j
have key := CategoryTheory.constant_of_preserves_morphisms
  (fun k : J => ULift.up.{u₁} (k ∈ p))
  (fun j₁ j₂ f => congrArg ULift.up (propext (h1 f))) j j₀
have i : (j ∈ p) = (j₀ ∈ p) := congrArg ULift.down key
exact (iff_of_eq i).mpr h0

name: Nat.div_dvd_div_left
script:
intro n m k hmk hnm
obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := hmk
obtain ⟨d, hd⟩ := hnm
rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos m with hm | hm
· subst hm
  simp at hc
  subst hc
  simp
· have hn : 0 < n := by
    rcases Nat.eq_zero_or_pos n with h | h
    · subst h; simp at hd; omega
    · exact h
  subst hc
  subst hd
  rw [Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hm, mul_assoc, Nat.mul_div_cancel_left _ hn]
  exact dvd_mul_left c d

name: Set.Finite.inv
script:
intro α _ s hs
have h : s⁻¹ = (fun x : α => x⁻¹) ⁻¹' s := by
  ext x; simp
rw [h]
first
  | exact hs.preimage inv_injective.injOn
  | exact hs.preimage (Set.injOn_of_injective inv_injective)
  | exact Set.Finite.preimage inv_injective.injOn hs
  | exact Set.Finite.preimage (Set.injOn_of_injective inv_injective _) hs
